{{AnimePokémonInfobox |nickname=Rara |jnickname=RURU |tmnickname=Ruru |image=[[File:Rara Gardevoir.png|150px]] |caption=Ruby's Gardevoir |location={{rt|34|Johto}} (by {{adv|Norman}}) |gender=Female |ability={{a|Synchronize}} |nature=Gentle |type1=Psychic |type2=Fairy |media=special |evolution=2 |epnum=PS181 |epname=Creeping Past Cacnea |numeps1=between 60 to 77 |numeps2=338 |firststagename=Ralts |secondstagename=Kirlia |pokemonname=Gardevoir |firstevoep=PS258 |secondevoep=PS596 |firstevoname=Rayquaza Redemption I |firstevonametiming=Prior to |secondevoname=Metagross Investigates |prevonum=280 |evo1num=281 |evo2num=282 |current=[[Party|With Ruby]] }} '''Rara''' (Japanese: '''{{tt|RURU|ルル}}'''), known as '''Ruru''' in [[Chuang Yi]]'s translations, is a {{p|Gardevoir}} that {{adv|Ruby}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and one of his [[List of characters' first Pokémon|first Pokémon]]. Rara was given to Ruby by his father, {{adv|Norman}}. She is at [[level]] 70, her [[Characteristic]] is that she "hates to lose", and she is used in {{OBP|Clever|condition|Smart}} {{pkmn|Contest}}s. ==History== ==={{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}=== [[File:Wally and Rara.png|thumb|left|200px|Rara and Wally]] Prior to the start of the manga, Rara was given to {{adv|Ruby}} as a {{p|Ralts}} as a {{pkmn2|gift}} from his father, {{adv|Norman}}. One day, when Ruby was playing with {{adv|Sapphire}}, a {{TP|Zinnia|Salamence}} attacked them and Ruby sent out Rara, [[Nana]], and [[Kiki]] to fend it off. The three managed to scare it away, but Ruby got injured in the process, which scared Sapphire. Because of this incident, Ruby decided to never battle in front of people again. Before moving to [[Hoenn]], Rara was used by Ruby to win multiple {{pkmn|Contest}}s in [[Johto]]. Rara first appeared as a Ralts in ''[[PS181|Creeping Past Cacnea]]'', where she was seen with Ruby on his trip to Hoenn. She is seen helping the [[Inside of Truck|moving truck]] get out of the mud by using {{m|Confusion}}. In ''[[PS187|Tongue-Tied Kecleon]]'', Rara is loaned to {{adv|Wally}} to help him catch his first Pokémon. Rara was sent out against a {{p|Kecleon}} and attacked with Confusion. Due to her relentless attacks, Kecleon tired himself out and was captured by Wally. Immediately after the {{pkmn|category|Color Swap Pokémon}}'s capture, an earthquake struck and tore the ground apart, throwing Ruby into the sea. With no way to get out, Ruby told Rara to stay with Wally and watch over him. After a long absence, Rara returned in ''[[PS240|Talk About Timing, Treecko]]'', still under Wally's care. It was revealed that the two traveled to [[Pacifidlog Town]] so Wally could have a better place to recover from his illness. While there, they got swept up by the storm caused by {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre}} and Rara soon sensed a [[Emerald's Sceptile|Treecko]] floating in the water. After saving him, Norman appeared and shared a happy reunion with Rara. The three of them then headed to the [[Sky Pillar]] for Wally's {{pkmn|training}}. Rara was used alongside Wally's other Pokémon to help him advance through the fifty floors. In ''[[PS258|Rayquaza Redemption I]]'', Rara was revealed to have [[Evolution|evolved]] into a {{p|Kirlia}} during the training at [[Sky Pillar]]. With the training complete, Norman sent Wally to the top of Sky Pillar to awaken {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Rayquaza}}. Once awakened, Rara used {{m|Imprison}} to keep it in place while {{p|Grovyle}} attacked with {{m|Bullet Seed}}. In ''[[PS267|It All Ends Now VIII]]'', Rara was returned to Ruby. ==={{MangaArc|Emerald}}=== [[File:Rara Synchronize.png|thumb|left|150px|Synchronize activated as a Kirlia]] [[File:Ruby and Rara.png|thumb|200px|Rara and Ruby]] In ''[[PS321|Cunning Kirlia]]'', Rara was used in Ruby's [[Battle Dome]] match against {{adv|Emerald}} and his {{TP|Emerald|Dusclops}}. The battle started with Rara using {{m|Hypnosis}} to put Dusclops to {{status|sleep}}, but the {{pkmn|category|Beckon Pokémon}} managed to break himself free from it and respond with a barrage of {{m|Shadow Ball}}s. Surprised to see Rara still standing from the onslaught, Emerald had Dusclops use {{m|Fire Punch}}, which left the Emotion Pokémon with a {{status|burn}}. Although Emerald thought that would help him win, Rara's {{a|Synchronize}} [[Ability]] activated, giving Dusclops a burn as well. This, coupled with Rara using {{m|Imprison}} to keep Dusclops from using Shadow Ball, led to both Pokémon [[fainting]], resulting in a tie. In ''[[PS334|The Final Battle VII]]'', Rara was seen battling [[Guile Hideout]]'s stolen {{gdis|Battle Tower|III}} Pokémon. ==={{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}=== In ''[[PS596|Metagross Investigates]]'', Sapphire borrowed Rara to train her alongside her own Kirlia, Kirly, with the intent on evolving them into a {{p|Gardevoir}} battle duo. When the two began evolving, Sapphire accidentally unearthed a [[Dawn Stone]] and kicked it towards Kirly. The stone caused Kirly to evolve into a {{p|Gallade}} while Rara evolved into Gardevoir. In ''[[PS605|Swampert Smashes]]'', Rara was reunited with Ruby, who was impressed by her new form. In [[PS615]], Rara was used alongside Kirly on top of Rayquaza to try and battle [[Zinnia]]. Though Rara used {{m|Misty Terrain}} to halve the damage from Zinnia's {{p|Salamence}}'s attack, Rara and Kirly are attacked by a {{p|Noivern}} that was assisting Zinnia. Noivern's {{m|Boomburst}} hits Rara and Kirly, knocking them out in the process. In [[PS616]], Ruby received a [[Gardevoirite]] from the {{OBP|Elder|Meteor Village}} of the [[Meteor Village]]. When Ruby was attacked by Sapphire due to a misunderstanding, he used Rara to defend himself from Kirly's attacks. When Sapphire had Kirly [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolve]] into Mega Gallade, Ruby retaliated by having Rara Mega Evolve into Mega Gardevoir. ==Personality and characteristics== [[File:Gardevoirite Galladite Adventures.png|thumb|right|150px|Rara's Gardevoirite]] Rara is intelligent and calm. Much like {{adv|Ruby}}, she is flashy, loves to show off her looks, and hates getting dirty. Rara is very close to Ruby, which is demonstrated by her ability to sense his emotions even when he is far away.
